Ensuring a steady supply for the countries most affected by the disease is essential. Additionally, these vaccines may provide considerable economic advantages for developing nations. Gavi aims to promote timely accessibility and widespread distribution of these immunizations.

items.title: RBI proposes framework to freeze only disputed amounts instead of entire accounts in cyber fraud cases
items.summary: Banks will soon freeze only disputed transaction amounts, not entire accounts. AI systems will monitor unusual transfers of one thousand rupees or more. Customers get twenty days to prove transaction legitimacy with supporting documents. Banks then have ten days to assess explanations and lift holds. Law enforcement will have thirty days to issue formal restraint orders after referral.

items.title: India, China agree to 'properly address' economic and trade concerns in a balanced manner
items.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal met Chinese counterpart Wang Wentao to implement key agreements. Leaders agreed to expand economic cooperation and address mutual concerns. They also emphasized viewing each other as partners, not rivals. Border peace remains essential for developing India-China relations. Both nations will coordinate more in multilateral forums like BRICS.

items.title: India, Brazil-led bloc Mercosur ink pact to accept electronic Certificates of Origin
items.summary: India and Mercosur have agreed to accept electronic Certificates of Origin. This move facilitates paperless trade and modernizes customs procedures between the two sides. The agreement allows electronic certificates to hold the same legal validity as paper documents. It is expected to reduce transaction costs and processing times significantly. The protocol will become effective after internal procedures are completed by all parties.

items.title: Average sugar retail price rules below Rs 60/kg for 4th day; festive demand keeps rates elevated

The government maintains adequate stocks despite a lowered production estimate.
